overall_quality.evidence: Garbage collection in Java is a process where the JVM automatically reclaims memory that is no longer in use by the application. It works by identifying objects that are no longer reachable from the application's root set and freeing up the memory they occupy. This process is managed by the JVM, which uses various algorithms to determine which objects can be safely discarded.
